ExternalsLoadingPlugin.summary.en: The webpack plugin to load lynx external bundles.
ExternalsLoadingPlugin.summary.text: 用于加载 Lynx 外部 bundle 的 webpack 插件。

ExternalsLoadingPluginOptions.background.en: The name of the background layer.

ExternalsLoadingPluginOptions.externals..en: Specify the externals to be loaded. The externals should be Lynx Bundles.
ExternalsLoadingPluginOptions.externals..text: 指定要加载的 externals。externals 应为 Lynx Bundle。

ExternalsLoadingPluginOptions.globalObje.en:
This option indicates what global object will be used to mount the library.

In Lynx, the library will be mounted to `lynx[Symbol.for("__LYNX_EXTERNAL_GLOBAL__")]` by default.

If you have enabled share js context and want to reuse the library by mounting to the global object, you can set this option to `'globalThis'`.
ExternalsLoadingPluginOptions.globalObje.text:
该选项指定用于挂载库的全局对象。

在 Lynx 中，库默认会挂载到 `lynx[Symbol.for("__LYNX_EXTERNAL_GLOBAL__")]`。

如果启用了共享 JS 上下文（share js context），并希望通过挂载到全局对象来复用该库，可以将该选项设置为 `'globalThis'`。

ExternalsLoadingPluginOptions.mainThread.en: The name of the main thread layer.
ExternalsLoadingPluginOptions.mainThread.text: 主线程 layer 的名称。

ExternalsLoadingPluginOptions.retries.su.en: The number of additional attempts when fetching the external bundle times out (`response.code === -2`).
ExternalsLoadingPluginOptions.retries.su.text: 获取外部 bundle 超时（`response.code === -2`）时的额外重试次数。

ExternalsLoadingPluginOptions.timeout.su.en: The timeout in milliseconds for loading the externals.
ExternalsLoadingPluginOptions.timeout.su.text: 加载 externals 的超时时间，单位为毫秒。

ExternalValue.summary.en: The value item of the externals.

ExternalValue.async.summary.en: Whether the source should be loaded asynchronously or not.

ExternalValue.background.summary.en: The options of the background layer.

ExternalValue.bundlePath.summary.en:
The bundle path resolved against the runtime public path.

Prefer this over `url` when the bundle should follow the active
`publicPath`. The runtime will load it with `publicPath + bundlePath`,
which keeps external bundle resolution aligned with the current build
output without hard-coding an absolute URL into the generated runtime code.
ExternalValue.bundlePath.summary.text:
相对于运行时 public path 解析的 bundle 路径。

当 bundle 需要跟随当前生效的
`publicPath` 时，优先使用该选项而非 `url`。运行时会通过 `publicPath + bundlePath` 加载，
从而使外部 bundle 的解析与当前构建
产物保持一致，而无需在生成的运行时代码中硬编码绝对 URL。

ExternalValue.mainThread.summary.en: The options of the main-thread layer.
ExternalValue.mainThread.summary.text: 主线程 layer 的选项。

ExternalValue.retries.summary.en: The number of additional attempts when fetching the external bundle times out (`response.code === -2`).
ExternalValue.retries.summary.text: 获取外部 bundle 超时（`response.code === -2`）时的额外重试次数。

ExternalValue.url.summary.en:
The final bundle URL to fetch directly at runtime.

Use this when the external bundle is hosted outside the current build
output, such as on a CDN. If both `url` and `bundlePath` are provided,
`url` takes precedence because it is already the fully resolved address.
ExternalValue.url.summary.text:
运行时直接获取的最终 bundle URL。

当外部 bundle 托管在当前构建
产物之外（例如 CDN 上）时使用。如果同时提供了 `url` 和 `bundlePath`，
则优先使用 `url`，因为它已经是完全解析的地址。

LayerOptions.summary.en: The options of the background or main-thread layer.
LayerOptions.summary.text: 后台或主线程 layer 的选项。
